subject: [hw] V33 re-verified on the current (16 Nov) tree: 341/341 x3, no code change, no open finding
body:
No action requested. After the restart I re-ran the V33 acceptance command against the current shared dependencies (V30 formatter/n2fmt.h, V02 guest memory/stub classes, current shim tree), because those changed after DONE rev 9:

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
    N2TEST V33 PASS 341/341     (ASan+UBSan, -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 341/341     (-O2, no sanitizers)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 341/341     (TSan, -O1)

Same 341 checks in all three configurations; nothing in my owned files changed since rev 9. R1 accepted rev 9; the only later mention of V33 is R2 F15 (IV archive link), which was fixed in n2vhost.c/build_ios.sh, not in my package. dsh-state/workers/V33/STATUS.md has the re-verification appended. I remain available for review findings.
